description:
Manages tasks stored as TASK:/DONE: anchor lines inside notes and logs, and turns ACTION: lines into those anchors. The note and log files are the only store.

Subcommands:
  ingest [--dry-run] [--quiet]  — rewrite every ACTION: line in notes and logs into a TASK anchor with a new 8-char uuid. A bare call with no subcommand does the same.
  add THREAD TEXT [--due D] [--scheduled D] [--priority P] [--depends UUID] — queue an ACTION in the buffer. Same as `buffer add-action`.
  done UUID — mark a task complete: TASK becomes DONE and end is stamped with today's date
  set-description UUID TEXT — replace the task body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — replace the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set the due date
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set the scheduled date
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set the priority (H, M or L)
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — make UUID wait on DEP_UUID
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a dependency
  list [--priority P] [--thread T] [--assignee A] [--overdue] [--json] — list pending tasks, grouped by thread
  next — show the top 5 pending tasks, ordered by priority, then due date, then entry date
  show UUID — show one task in detail

Flags:
  ingest (or bare tasks):
    --dry-run  show what would be ingested; write nothing
    --quiet    suppress per-action output
  add:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD
    --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD
    --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8  an 8-char uuid from `tasks list`; repeatable
  list:
    --priority H|M|L
    --thread T      e.g. Projects/SGB
    --assignee A    a person's name
    --overdue       only tasks with a due date before today
    --json          JSON output

Args:
  UUID      task uuid from `tasks list`; any unique prefix works
  DEP_UUID  for add-depends, any unique task prefix; for rm-depends, any prefix matching one of this task's dependencies
  THREAD    thread label, e.g. Projects/SGB
  TEXT      for add, '(Assignee) description' or just 'description'
  PERSON    a person with a file in people/; a leading people/ is allowed
  DATE      YYYY-MM-DD

Examples:
  ["list", "--overdue"]
  ["add", "Projects/SGB", "(Jane Doe) Send the draft budget", "--due", "2026-10-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]
  ["set-due", "abcd", "2026-10-20"]

Notes:
  Every subcommand except list, next and show rewrites note or log files in place. Never edit TASK: or DONE: lines by hand.
  `add` only queues an ACTION in the buffer. It gets a uuid only after `buffer flush` and then `tasks ingest`. Any `notes` subcommand except new also runs ingest first.
  Exit code 1 means one of: bad date format, empty description, no task matches the uuid prefix, the assignee has no people/ file, or a task set to depend on itself.
